children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 I have become the industry’s largest player by capacity, though I have a legacy of less than two decades.
2 My billionaire founder is a third-generation entrepreneur, and all three generations distinguished themselves in the profession.
3 My founder’s father was awarded the Padma Bhushan, while his grandfather received the Padma Shri.

4 I have served about seven million customers in a highly fragmented industry and may become the first to cross the 10-million mark if I continue growing aggressively through both organic and inorganic routes.
5 While I am no longer in the ₹1-lakh-crore market-capitalisation club, my aggressive growth and favourable industry tailwinds could enable me to rejoin it soon.

title: Who Am I? November 15, 2026
